selection_reason: CSW-07 completed_verified in PR #437. CSW-02, CSW-05 and CSW-07 satisfy CSW-08 dependencies; the owner-approved interleave selects CSW-08 before APW-05.
objective: Define Reuse, Remix and Transformation so creators can clone, adapt, template, fork and transform creative artifacts across projects/settings while preserving exact provenance, independent identities/versions, inherited-reference visibility, source-version conflict behavior and explicit Campaign/runtime-to-reusable boundaries without silently mutating sources or live Campaign truth.
completion_gate: A creator can reuse and transform material across projects with clear provenance, independent versions and no unintended mutation of the source or live Campaign state, while source-version conflicts and inherited visibility/reference constraints remain explicit and recoverable.
required_design_questions: What exact clone/adapt/template/fork/remix relationship semantics distinguish independent derivative identity from source identity?
How can Character/NPC/location/lore/history/prose/plot material become hooks, seeds, rumors, conflicts, scenes or Adventure candidates without pretending the transform is authoritative truth?
How does Campaign-runtime-to-reusable clone/propose preserve A10/APW ownership, hidden-information and provenance boundaries?
What World-to-World and Campaign-to-Campaign adaptation operations are permitted and what must remain proposal/review/incorporation-controlled?
How are creator templates/starter kits versioned and instantiated without silent source linkage or executable authority?
How are exact source IDs/versions, accepted transforms and contributor/AI provenance retained through multi-generation derivation?
How are inherited governed references handled when the destination context lacks access or compatibility?
What happens when a source changes after derivative creation: ignore, compare, manual adapt or explicit rebase candidate?
How are compare/rebase/manual-adapt semantics defined without Git-like complexity becoming mandatory UX?
How are cross-setting/system/schema/pack compatibility warnings advisory and evidence-backed rather than destructive blockers?
How do CSW-07 exact revisions/spans and style/voice profiles participate in transforms without source-history mutation?
How do privacy, export, optional AI, recovery, mobile and nonvisual parity apply to derivative workflows?
next_action: Execute CSW-08 as a bounded design/governance tranche defining derivative identity/relationship semantics, reusable transformation families, runtime-to-reusable and cross-context boundaries, provenance/reference inheritance, source-version conflict/rebase/manual-adapt behavior, compatibility analysis, optional assistance and recovery/accessibility acceptance.
